content:
Total distinct student pairs:
\[
\binom{289}{2}=\frac{289\cdot 288}{2}=41616
\]

Pairs formed per day:
\[
17\binom{17}{2}=17\cdot 136=2312
\]

So the number of days is at most:
\[
\frac{41616}{2312}=18
\]

This bound is attainable using the affine plane of order \(17\), so the largest possible number of days is

\[
\boxed{18}
\]
